key_insight: LapMerge introduces a differentiable token-merging method that can reduce sequence length while preserving information under an exact budget. It does this in linear time for ordered sequences, making token compression more practical for long-context models.
problem_solved: The paper addresses the high cost of processing long token sequences in vision and language models. Existing token reduction methods either discard information when selecting tokens or rely on expensive pairwise/token-to-output interactions when merging.
method: Uses a learned mass distribution over an ordered token sequence to partition tokens for merging.
Provides a differentiable merging operator that preserves information better than hard token selection.
Achieves exact-budget compression in linear time, avoiding the quadratic costs common in prior merging approaches.
impact: LapMerge can help reduce inference and training cost for models that handle long sequences, especially in vision and language tasks. For practitioners, it offers a more efficient way to compress tokens without giving up as much information as traditional pruning or merging methods.

paper_title: LapMerge: Differentiable Exact-Budget Token Merging in Linear Time
paper_authors: Magdalena Trędowicz, Aleksandra Nowak, Tomasz Steifer, Łukasz Struski, Szymon Płotka
